description: This file defines the 'PinnedMessages' class responsible for managing pinned message indices within a session, including loading and saving pinned message state to local storage.

classes.name: PinnedMessages
classes.description: A class managing a set of pinned message indices, with functionality to load, save, pin, unpin, toggle, and clear pins for a given session key.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the PinnedMessages instance with a session key and loads existing pinned message data.

methods.name: indices
methods.description: Getter that returns the current set of pinned message indices.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a given index is pinned.

methods.name: pin
methods.description: Pins a message at a given index and saves the state.

methods.name: unpin
methods.description: Unpins a message at a given index and saves the state.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles the pin state of a given index.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads pinned message indices from local storage for the current session key.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current set of pinned message indices to local storage.
